lines.en: Sharp beak glides through the silent night
Flaps wings between withered branches
Whispers with a threat in its voice
Predator eyes like torches
Flies silently beneath the night
Crawls for food beneath the dead leaves
Flashes in the darkness
Slips by silently
Lurks in the shadows
Wings slice through the still night

lines.zh: 掠过腐叶，翅尖扫起尘土
lines.en: Skimming the leaf litter, dust in my wake

lines.zh: 枯枝断在爪下，我继续飞
lines.en: The branch snaps under my claws; I fly on
Stands on a withered branch
Gazes into the distant darkness
Occasionally whispers to itself
Eyes pierce like daggers
Vanishes in the night
Silently awaits
Fixes on prey for a long time
I perch on the branch, silent.
Blends in the moonlight
Stands silently in the quiet
Wings folded, hidden in a hollow
Head tilted, listening to falling leaves
Honing my beak, waiting for deeper night
Old blood still crusts my feathers
Instantly locks on to the player

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，羽毛竖起来。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you, feathers raised.
Stares at the player for a moment
Skeptically watches the player
Eyes gleam with malice
Holds the player's gaze
Locks on to the player
My feathers fell out, and you're still staring.
Fixes on the player
Stares intently at the player
In the light you stand out too clearly
Your torch has found me
I tilt my head at your pack
Your fingers tighten on the hilt.

lines.zh: 你踩断的树枝出卖了你
lines.en: The twig you broke gave you away
Look up. I'm perched above you
I see you as one meal
Three steps closer. That's enough
My wings are hurt. Cure me!
Fix my wings, please!
My wings are bitten, hurt!
My wings are injured, help me!
My wings are smashed, it hurts!
Help, my wings are hurt!
My wings are injured, it hurts so much!
My wings are hurt, hurry up!
My wings are cut, it hurts!
My wings are hurt, save me quickly!

lines.zh: 你散发的光让我心烦，远离我！
lines.en: The light you emit bothers me, stay away!

lines.zh: 你的气息像毒药，别靠近！
lines.en: Your scent is like poison, don't come near!

lines.zh: 你身上有我猎物的味道，走开！
lines.en: You smell like prey, get away from me!

lines.zh: 不要诱惑我，我要吃掉你！
lines.en: Don't tempt me, I'll eat you!
The grains in your hand are gleaming.

lines.zh: 你的存在让我不安，快消失！
lines.en: Your presence unsettles me, go away!

lines.zh: 你太接近了，让我喘不过气！
lines.en: You're too close, it's hard to breathe!

lines.zh: 你散发的光辉让我头晕目眩！
lines.en: Your shining light makes me dizzy!

lines.zh: 别靠近我，否则我会攻击你！
lines.en: Stay away or I'll attack you!

lines.zh: 靠近我会让你付出代价的！
lines.en: Coming too close will cost you!
You're blocking my way, move!
You've bumped into me, silly!

lines.zh: 你撞上了我不舒服，闪开！
lines.en: It's uncomfortable when you bump into me, get out of the way!
Don't block the path, let me pass!
You're blocking my view, get out of the way!

lines.zh: 你挡住了我的去路，让我通过！
lines.en: You're blocking my path, let me through!
You've bumped into me, that was dangerous!
You're blocking me, move aside!
Don't block the path, I need space!
You've bumped into me, that was unexpected!

lines.zh: 找你的同类去吧，我不感兴趣！
lines.en: Find your mate, I'm not interested!

lines.zh: 不要缠着我，找你同类去！
lines.en: Don't bother me, find your mate!

lines.zh: 别靠近我，我已经有伴侣了！
lines.en: Stay away, I'm already mated!
You're not my type, go away!
Stop bothering me, find someone else!

lines.zh: 你别过来，我已经有伴侣了！
lines.en: Don't come near, I'm already mated!

lines.zh: 去找你的同类，别打扰我！
lines.en: Find your mate, don't bother me!
Stop bothering me, I'm busy!
You're not my choice, go away!
Three calls, then I wait for an answer
Feather feels cold like night.
Whispers carry death’s scent.
Predator’s wings are still wet.
Feathers hold ill omen.
Hides in the night’s shadow.
Feather is its only weapon.
Creeps silently near you.
Cold wings glide over skin.
Whispers from decayed lands.
I pick up something bright
Locked onto your scent.
Your shadow entered sight.
Your presence can’t be ignored.
You are part of the hunt.
Your figure appeared in vision.
Scent guides me to you.
I saw you behind the tree.
I will taste your fear.
Focuses on you.
Your voice enters my ear.
The air under my wings has shifted
I hear your heartbeat now
A new outline in the tree shadows
Your warmth drifts up to me
I know that footstep
The wind brings your scent
Places you in a death trap.
Your flesh is my prey.
Aiming at your fatal flaw.
You face a death sentence.
Ready to enjoy your pain.
Locking in the fatal blow.

lines.zh: 你将在我的注视下死去
lines.en: You will die under my gaze.
Your end has come.
I will make you fear.

lines.zh: 你将化为我口中的晚餐
lines.en: You will be my evening meal.
I circle to the tree behind you
Each time you move, I come closer
My talons are past the branch tip

lines.zh: 你退到哪棵树下都一样
lines.en: Any tree you back under, I'm there
I count your steps
The night hides my wings

lines.zh: 你听见枝叶响，那就是我
lines.en: If the leaves rustle, that's me
I'm waiting for you to look up
Sharp beak at your chest!
Bony wings swing, splattering blood.
Sharp talons tear your skin!

lines.zh: 羽毛在你耳边沙沙作响！
lines.en: Feathers rustle near your ear!

lines.zh: 掠食本能，只求一击毙命！
lines.en: Predatory instinct, aiming for a one-hit kill!
Bony wings flap, blood in the wind!
Bone beak pierces your throat!
Bone claws rip your flesh!
Decaying body, incredibly fierce!
Bone friction, hissing!
My beak sinks into your shoulder!
Claws hook your collar!
My wings beat your sight away!
Dropping straight down from the tree!
A peck at your neck!
A face full of feathers!
Appears suddenly in the darkness!
Act at nightfall!
Hatch from a腐朽的巢穴!
Decaying feathers fall to the ground!
Lurks among the deadwood!
Decaying flesh draws it out!
They gather in the corrupted land!
Its moan echoes in the wind!
Decaying scent permeates the area!
Its outline drifts through the night!
A dark shape settles on the dead branch
A strange cry rings through the woods
I squeeze out of the hollow
In the dark, wingbeats come closer
Dead leaves lift under my wings
On the branch, I open my eyes
I hatched from the rotting leaves
Somewhere in the shade, a beak is honed

lines.zh: 翅膀受伤了，快治伤吧，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My wings are hurt. Cure me! — and the fire makes it worse.
Save me, I'm on fire!

lines.zh: 翅膀破了，求治疗，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Fix my wings, please! — and the drown makes it worse.
Help, I'm injured by an explosion!

lines.zh: 翅膀被咬了，疼，中箭的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My wings are bitten, hurt! — and the projectile makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我被魔法击中了，救救我！
lines.en: I'm hit by magic, save me!

lines.zh: 翅膀受了伤，救救我，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My wings are injured, help me! — and the starvation makes it worse.
I'm struck by lightning, save me!

lines.zh: 翅膀被砸了，好疼，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My wings are smashed, it hurts! — and the void makes it worse.
